## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `development` (only a hotfix targets `main`)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run build` passes when the build, the service worker or configuration changed
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes when people can see the change
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] Texts are added to every language in `src/features/i18n/model/messages/`
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` is updated
- [ ] A user-visible change has a line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] The UI was checked in light and dark mode, with Full and Reduced effects, in forced colours mode, at 320 px, in a long language such as German and with the keyboard
